767-2757-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least three charge counters on it.
767-2757-4687.description:
Activate a basic Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic Forest or Island.
Activate the Forest or Island by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

323-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1703-2292-4984.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
1251-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3532-5078-6289-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6289-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.
1123-2034-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

2034-2457-7363-7426.description:
Activate a Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Ant creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1479-2783-2841-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2783-2841-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2963-5902-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2963-5902-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

141-2511-2562.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

2448-4699-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2448-4699-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2511-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

360-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-3197-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

478-804-2821-3488-6745.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3488-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
478-804-2821-3488-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Katsumasa.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1808-5231-6291.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {R}.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

1429-2018-2099.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Lesser Masticore didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

413-4616-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-4616-6249--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1162-2939.notablePrerequisites:
Angelic Enforcer does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1162-2939.description:
Declare Angelic Enforcer as an attacker.
Angelic Enforcer triggers, doubling your life total.
Defiant Bloodlord triggers, causing target opponent whose life total is less than or equal to Angelic Enforcer's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
That opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

413-1496-3263-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
413-1496-3263-4078-4242.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

171-3492-3609-5295.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Palace Siege triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2047-3340.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight in any combination of lands and/or Treasure tokens.
2047-3340.description:
On the end step before your turn, activate all lands you control by tapping them, creating that many Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
